P8m: When a conflict between two principles leads to a rule, don't only keep the rule. Keep the original case on file too: what happened, what principles actually conflicted, what judgments were made first, what was finally decided and the rationale, what the dissenting opinions were, what the consequences were, and under what version of the rule it was decided. When the rule changes, re-run the case. Otherwise every generation gets to rediscover the same constitutional fight from scratch.
